title: Constructible etale derived internal Hom preserves bounded-below coproducts
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning a scheme [def-pc-scheme] admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring. Use the ordinary derived category $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A_X$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $K$ have cohomology zero above some integer $r$. Assume every $H^j(K)$ admits a finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification] on whose strata it is locally constant with finitely generated $A$-module stalks [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $I$ be any set in the coefficient universe [def-weil-size-convention], and let $(L_i)_{i\in I}$ be objects of $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ with a common lower cohomological bound: there is $c\in\mathbf Z$ such that $H^j(L_i)=0$ for every $i$ and $j<c$. Coproducts mean coproducts in this ordinary derived category, computed by direct sums of representing complexes. Then the canonical map induced by the coproduct inclusions
$$\bigoplus_{i\in I}R\mathcal Hom_A(K,L_i)\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_A\left(K,\bigoplus_{i\in I}L_i\right)$$
is an isomorphism, where derived internal Hom is [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. No finite generation or constructibility of $L_i$, no upper bound on $L_i$, no finite Tor amplitude of $K$, and no uniform upper bound on the displayed Hom objects is assumed.
